authority: Existing V2 asset origins, scene transforms, shared material names and 2D gameplay authority; no new layout
scope: DEV visual authoring rules, not universal production tolerances

rules.stone_counter_bevel: min(counter_depth * 0.07, 0.042); keeps V2 countertop surface at 1.08
rules.cedar_counter_joinery: end-post bevel tracks member thickness; front fields recessed relative to projecting stiles; underside/plinth remain darker
rules.chair_legs: tapered continuous quad members; bevel = min(end widths) * 0.16
rules.chair_crest: continuous swept quad strip; bevel = min(section width, depth) * 0.22
rules.chair_cushion: rounded superellipse sections with a domed top, rather than a beveled block
rules.window: nested cedar jamb/bead depths within existing 1.6-wide left-ground-origin module; separate existing sill remains in place
rules.espresso: extruded shaped side profile and stepped cup deck; preserves countertop-contact-center origin
rules.plants: four deterministic role templates; broad curved leaves with folded midrib; same seven V2 instance positions; low-sided stems and shared opaque two-sided foliage material
rules.material: Reuse exact V2 ShaderMaterial resources and all five first-party painted albedos; intrinsic geometric cavity in vertex red, foliage pigment in green; no baked directional light or generated new pixels

future_calibration: These DEV dimensions/bevel choices are authored design parameters fitted to existing assets, not approved category calibration thresholds. New template families need their own authority measurements and human review.
